title: PARALLAX decision identity and causal outcome time hardened
summary: PARALLAX now binds idempotent decisions to action, regime, asset, observation time, context/provenance, exact source commit, and the immutable branch plan. Decision and outcome timestamps must be timezone-aware, and a branch outcome cannot be recorded before its parent decision. These checks close silent identity-alias and backdated-outcome paths while preserving PARALLAX/DREAMSTATE as shadow-only research systems.
